axes.name: Clutter (edge density)
axes.definition: Share of pixels that sit on an edge in the rendered screen; a proxy for visual clutter (nav_glance cites Mack & Oliva 2004). The owner's complaint was options that are 'difficult to parse at a glance'.

measurement.inputs: PNG render (headless Edge, 360x740 phone, 1100x660 desktop), light and dark
measurement.formula: grey = PIL convert('L'); edges = ImageFilter.FIND_EDGES; clutter = count(edge px >= 40/255) / (w*h); mean over light+dark. User-data dotted outlines are hidden before measuring (.score .ud{outline:none}).
measurement.range: 0..1; Factotum screens 0.018-0.057; reference apps 0.011 (Loop) .. 0.079 (Anytype), scaled to 360 px wide

axes.aggregation: Objective in every Pareto front (phone 'clutter' and 'desk_clutter' separately); differences < 0.002 treated as ties. In toast/t2/t3 parts it sits in a 'Calm' axis summed by ranks.
axes.validation: Threshold robustness checked in nav-glance.md at 20/40/80/120: depth coding beat plain and hue in 48/48 at every threshold. reference_clutter() measures real apps' screenshots for calibration. Controls (busy header 0.034 vs 0.033; dense rows 0.057 vs 0.036-0.040) lose.
axes.scifin_reason: Pure pixel metric; works on any Sci-Fin PNG at known density once scaled to 360 dp wide.
axes.port_inputs: PNG per screen per theme, plus a dp scale factor to normalise to 360 dp width; optional mask for user data

axes.name: Strong (full-contrast) targets / nav at full contrast
axes.definition: Tappable elements whose effective contrast against their nearest painted background is >= 7:1 (strong) and the subset in header/bar/rail (strong_nav): 'what the eye lands on first. Fewer = calmer, as long as the main action is among them.'

measurement.inputs: DOM via headless browser: [data-tap] elements, computed colour, opacity chain, nearest ancestor background with alpha > 0.5
measurement.formula: L_text_eff = L_text*opacity + L_bg*(1-opacity); ratio = (max+0.05)/(min+0.05); strong = count(ratio >= 7); strong_nav = count(ratio>=7 and inside .hdr/.bar/.rail)

axes.aggregation: strong_nav in T1 Pareto low-set; nav_glance 'primary' counted nav items at full strength (depth coding: 2-3).
axes.validation: T1.1 control (busy header) had strong_nav 5 vs 2 and lost.
axes.scifin_reason: Useful for keeping the money figure / Add the only loud things; needs the probe to give fg/bg colour per element instead of DOM.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with element bounds, role (nav/action), text colour, resolved background colour and alpha

axes.name: Faint labels
axes.definition: Tappable labelled targets whose text reads under 4.5:1 on its own background, opacity included: 'receding must not mean unreadable' (WCAG 1.4.3).

measurement.inputs: DOM via headless browser (same contrast probe as strong_targets)
measurement.formula: faint = {name contrast | contrast < 4.5}; faint_n = len(phone)+len(desktop)

axes.validation: Found the opacity .65 bar labels at 2.4:1 (kit.py:58 comment), fixed to colour-based receding.
axes.scifin_reason: Any Compose element with text; Sci-Fin probes can supply text colour + surface colour.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: element bounds, isClickable, text colour, background colour, alpha

axes.name: Taps under 48 dp
axes.source: tools/screens/screen_score.py:173; gate in toast_opt.py ranked() (rows with 'small' excluded); t3_opt measure2 gate: primary 48 dp, chips 24 dp
axes.definition: Tappable elements whose hit box is under 48x48 dp (Material, WCAG 2.5.8 comfortable size).

measurement.inputs: DOM bounds of [data-tap] at device scale 1 (px == dp)
measurement.formula: count(w < 48 or h < 48), phone + desktop

axes.aggregation: Pareto objective in T1; in later parts a hard gate (an option with small targets cannot reach the front).
axes.validation: Caught 22 px check circles and 36 px chips (kit.py:53, tier_t1 T13_CSS comment) and the dense-row control (Done 11x19).
axes.scifin_reason: Compose probe bounds at known density give dp directly.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: clickable element bounds in dp, role (primary vs chip)

axes.name: Blank lead column
axes.definition: Rows whose slot before the title shows nothing (no text, ::before mark, border or fill): an empty left column that wastes width and breaks scanning.

measurement.inputs: DOM: .zone .row, children before .t
measurement.formula: count rows where no sibling before the title 'shows' (text, ::before content, border>0, or non-transparent background)

axes.aggregation: Reported in T1.2 row table; front over clutter/edges/blank.
axes.validation: T1.2: options B/C had 4 blank leads and were dominated.
axes.scifin_reason: Transaction rows with optional category icon could leave blank leads; needs row/slot semantics in the probe.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with list rows, child slots (leading/title/trailing) and whether each draws anything

axes.name: Distinct left edges (title_edges / edges)
axes.source: tools/screens/screen_score.py:66-68 (title_edges); capture_v2.py:213-221 (edges); form_opt.py, picker_opt.py (edges of sections)
axes.definition: How many distinct x positions titles or rows start at, summed per zone; 1 per zone is one clean edge (alignment).

measurement.inputs: DOM bounds of titles/rows
measurement.formula: sum over zones of |{round(title.left)}|; capture variant: |{round(x) of line, first chip/kind, route}|

axes.aggregation: Pareto objective (T1.2) and member of Harmony 'H' axis (capture_v2, form_opt, picker_opt, legend_opt) via rank sums.
axes.validation: T1.2 control had 4 edges vs 2 for the front.
axes.scifin_reason: Ledger rows, budget cards and goal rows all have title text whose left x is in the probe.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: text element bounds with role=title and container/zone id

axes.name: Rows in view (density)
axes.definition: Item rows wholly inside the phone's content area: 'how much of the day fits at a glance'.

measurement.inputs: DOM: .body .row bounds vs .body bounds (later: above the bar's top)
measurement.formula: count(row.top >= body.top and row.bottom <= body.bottom)

axes.aggregation: 'Density' axis (-rows_seen) in t2/t3 rank sums, together with cut titles.
axes.scifin_reason: Transactions per screen above the tab bar on 360 dp.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: list row bounds, content viewport bounds (above tab bar)

axes.name: Smallest text
axes.definition: The smallest font size of any visible text node, in px; T1 scores the shortfall below a 14 px floor.

measurement.inputs: DOM text nodes with non-zero box, computed font-size
measurement.formula: min_text = min(fontSize); min_text_short = max(0, 14 - min_text); capture line text_small = 18 - font

axes.aggregation: min_text_short in T1 Pareto low-set; '-min_text' in Legibility axes.
axes.scifin_reason: Probe can report sp per text; scale-aware.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: text nodes with font size in sp/dp

axes.name: Nav out of thumb reach (top quarter)
axes.definition: On a phone, header/bar/rail targets centred in the top quarter of the screen, 'the zone a thumb reaches worst (Hoober 2013)'. Variant far_primary: main action out of reach.

measurement.inputs: DOM tap centres + nav flag; viewport h
measurement.formula: count(nav and y_centre < 0.25*h) if width < 600 else 0

axes.validation: T1.1 control (busy header) 5 vs 0-2.
axes.scifin_reason: Directly answers where Add / period switcher sit on 360 dp.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: clickable bounds with role (nav/primary), screen height

axes.name: Steps to targets (on screen or declared)
axes.definition: For each named target (Search, Capture, Hub, Settings), 1 if a tappable element with that name is on screen, else the option's declared route length.

measurement.inputs: DOM tap names + hand-declared routes
measurement.formula: steps[t] = 1 if t in names else declared[t]; steps_sum = sum

axes.scifin_reason: Add, budgets, goals and search reachable in one tap vs a route.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: clickable elements with semantic names/contentDescription; declared routes for absent targets

axes.name: Needed targets not seen (hit-tested)
axes.definition: Targets a task needs that are not drawn: centre outside the viewport, or the topmost element at the centre is not the target (covered or clipped). Owner's rule: 'everything a task needs is drawn in its own view'.

measurement.inputs: DOM: elementFromPoint at each target centre within frame w x h
measurement.formula: seen = centre in viewport and hit === el or el.contains(hit); hidden = |needed| - |seen|; hidden_by(before, after) = per-name drop in seen counts when an overlay appears

axes.aggregation: Often a constraint (Hub: 0 hidden required); else in Ease/Cover axes.
axes.validation: Fixed 2026-10-08: headless --dump-dom laid out at 492x648 whatever the window, so the page is now measured in a larger window with hit-test bounds at the frame size; T1.4's earlier position-only count was wrong for cards cut by the sheet edge.
axes.scifin_reason: Compose semantics tree gives bounds but not occlusion; needs z-order or a pixel check to decide 'covered'.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with bounds, z-order/overlay membership, viewport; list of needed targets per task

axes.name: Thumb reach (Fitts' index of difficulty)
axes.definition: Shannon-form Fitts' ID from where the thumb (or pointer) rests to each target, mean over the targets a task uses (MacKenzie 1992).

measurement.inputs: Target centre and box from DOM; a stated rest point
measurement.formula: ID = log2(hypot(rest - centre) / min(w, h) + 1); reach = mean over targets

constants.desktop: pointer from last place; travel in px

axes.aggregation: In Ease axes almost everywhere (reach, reach_log, reach_skip, fitts_add, fitts_form).
axes.validation: capture_opt model re-measured from renders by tier_t1 (model checked against the page). Reference apps measured on the owner's phone (capture-opt.md).
axes.scifin_reason: Placement of Add, amount keypad confirm, and tab bar on 360 dp; rest point bottom-centre.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON bounds (dp) + stated rest points per context (no keyboard, keyboard up)

axes.name: Actions over a task set (walked)
axes.definition: Taps + keystrokes + drags (wheel steps counted one by one) to complete a fixed task set, walked along paths written beside each variant; a later target hidden by a raised keyboard costs one more action to close it.

measurement.inputs: Static model of the variant's paths, cross-checked against DOM for visibility
measurement.formula: sum over tasks of (taps + keys + drags); keyboard 290 px when a field is tapped; typing assumes no autocomplete

axes.aggregation: Ease axis; in T3 Measuring parts it LEADS: only options within a tolerance (0.17-0.25 taps) of the best can reach the front.
axes.validation: Wheel steps counted individually after the owner's correction (14:30 from 09:00 = 11 actions).
axes.scifin_reason: Entering an expense, setting a budget, editing a recurring bill are walkable task sets.
axes.port_inputs: declared task paths per variant (static), plus probe to confirm each step's target is visible

axes.name: Frequency-weighted taps including scrolls (or search)
axes.definition: Every item's typical use weighted by how often it happens, plus the scrolls needed to bring its control into view, or a search when cheaper; scored at two list sizes and the worse rank counts. Owner: taller cards 'increase the amount of scrolling ... and hide a lot of trackers'.

measurement.inputs: DOM bounds of each item's control, viewport bottom (bar top), list page height; usage frequency profile
measurement.formula: scrolls = 0 if bottom <= vb else ceil((bottom - vb)/page); reach_cost = min(scrolls + fold_tap, SEARCH_COST); cost = sum f*(entry_taps + visits*reach_cost)/sum f

axes.aggregation: max-of-ranks across sizes ('max:' keys); leads the front.
axes.validation: Replaced T3b.1b because scroll was undercounted (owner, 2026-10-13).
axes.scifin_reason: Category/account pickers and budget lists at small and large counts; frequency profile from spending categories.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON of list at N=12 and N=40, viewport/tab-bar bounds, per-item frequency table

axes.name: Overview (items in view) and screens spanned
axes.definition: Share of items in view or behind a label header in view (one tap), and how many screens the list spans.

measurement.inputs: DOM bounds of items/headers vs viewport
measurement.formula: overview = in_view/N; screens = ceil(list_height / page)

axes.aggregation: Overview axis, max of ranks over 12/30/40 items.
axes.scifin_reason: How many budgets/categories/accounts are visible without scrolling.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON at multiple list sizes

axes.name: Share of screen covered by an overlay
axes.source: tools/screens/form_opt.py docstring (covered), picker_opt.py (covered), toast_opt.py:296 (cover_px), t2_opt score_alarm (cover_kpx), empty_opt (block_px, banner_px), capture sheet_h (screen_score.py:72-74)
axes.definition: How much of the underlying screen a sheet, picker, toast, banner or dialog hides; capture sheet height above the keyboard as the special case ('less hides less of Today').

measurement.inputs: DOM bounds of the overlay and the viewport
measurement.formula: covered = overlay_area / (w*h); sheet_h = sheet.height (or keyboard.top - cover.top for opaque full covers)

axes.scifin_reason: Add-transaction sheet vs full page; how much of the ledger stays visible.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: overlay bounds, keyboard bounds if any

axes.name: Context kept (rows still visible behind)
axes.source: tools/screens/t2_opt.py AXES 'page' Context (-context_rows); t3_opt addsent/addhabit; toast_opt line_covered (screen_score.py:81)
axes.definition: Rows of the list still visible while an item page/sheet is open; line_covered: whether the typed capture line is hidden by something above it (sampled at 10/50/90% of its width).

measurement.inputs: DOM hit-test
measurement.formula: context_rows = count(list rows seen with overlay open); line_covered = any(elementFromPoint(x_f, y_mid) not in line, f in {0.1,0.5,0.9})

axes.aggregation: Context axis; line_covered in Cover axis.
axes.scifin_reason: Seeing the ledger or budget while entering an expense.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with overlay state, bounds and z-order

axes.name: Visual mass and emphasis coherence
axes.source: tools/screens/sheet_weight.py:45-56; capture_v2.py:153-176, 196-205; hub_opt.py:141; picker_opt.py:183 (heavy); t2_opt.py:1055 (mass, dismiss_pull)
axes.definition: Mass = summed departure of each pixel's luminance from the region's ground tone, per element box; checks that the content outweighs the button that submits it and that the two heaviest elements follow the declared importance order. Owner: a big black check 'creates a huge imbalance between the elements on the sheet'.

measurement.inputs: PNG crop + DOM element boxes
measurement.formula: ground = modal luma bin (32 bins); mass(box) = sum |luma - ground|; add_share = mass(add)/mass(sheet); add_vs_line = mass(add)/mass(line) (<= 1); heavy = max element share; headers share; dismiss_pull = m_dismiss/(m_dismiss+m_snooze); emphasis = designkit layout.emphasis_coherence(top2 by mass, importance order)

axes.aggregation: Harmony axis (rank sum) in capture_v2/v3/v4, hub_opt, picker, repeat3; 'Half-asleep' axis in alarm.
axes.validation: Added because the reach-only search could not see the imbalance (sheet_weight docstring).
axes.scifin_reason: Does the balance figure outweigh the Add button and the chart; is Delete heavier than Save.
axes.port_inputs: PNG at known density + probe JSON bounds with roles and a declared importance order

axes.name: Distinct drawn heights (one shape decision) and over-box
axes.definition: Distinct drawn heights among a sheet's controls and chips (craftkit's 'one shape decision'); over_box counts controls drawn taller than the text box beside them (owner rule, a constraint = 0).

measurement.inputs: DOM boxes of drawn (visual) parts, separate from their 48 px hit targets (.vis[data-vis])
measurement.formula: heights = |{h of vis}|; over_box = count(h > linebox.h)

axes.scifin_reason: Needs probe to distinguish drawn shape bounds from touch-target bounds (Compose minimumInteractiveComponentSize).
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with both drawn bounds and touch bounds per control

axes.name: Sprawl (craftkit ui findings)
axes.definition: Count of craftkit ui warnings plus off-grid spacing notes on the sheet alone, colour and contrast codes excluded ('nothing wins on colour' before the palette).

measurement.inputs: HTML page through creative-design-suite craftkit_cli ui --json
measurement.formula: count(findings with severity warn/error or code spacing-off-grid, code not starting colour/contrast)

axes.scifin_reason: Depends on craftkit parsing HTML/CSS; Compose renders are not HTML. A spacing-on-grid check from probe bounds could replace it.
axes.port_inputs: would need a probe-based 8 dp grid check instead

axes.name: Unjustified empty space
axes.definition: Share of a region's grid cells with almost no detail (craftkit imgstat _detail_report on a Sobel map); from the owner's concern about 'unjustified empty space'.

measurement.inputs: PNG crop of the region
measurement.formula: imgstat._detail_report(_sobel(luma)).empty_share

axes.aggregation: Reported/ranked in capture_v3, hub_opt (C axis), repeat3 (beside density).
axes.scifin_reason: Pixel-only, but needs the imgstat cell size/threshold reimplemented (simple Sobel + grid).
axes.port_inputs: PNG + region bounds

axes.name: Focal point and left/right balance
axes.definition: Where edge energy concentrates (and whether it lands on the content or on the action), and the share of mass left of centre.

measurement.inputs: PNG crop + element boxes
measurement.formula: imgstat._focal_report (edge-energy centroid) mapped to element box; balance = mass_left/mass_total

axes.aggregation: Reported in sheet_weight.json; not a ranked axis elsewhere.
axes.scifin_reason: Focal on the money figure is the check Sci-Fin wants; needs edge-energy centroid code.
axes.port_inputs: PNG + probe bounds with role

axes.name: Controls count and density per 100 px
axes.definition: Tappable controls on a sheet, and controls per 100 px of sheet height (crowding).

measurement.inputs: DOM taps inside the sheet bounds
measurement.formula: controls = count(taps with top >= sheet.top); density = controls / (sheet_h/100)

axes.aggregation: Clutter axis (controls); Density axis in repeat3.
axes.scifin_reason: Add-transaction sheet crowding.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON clickable bounds + sheet bounds

axes.name: Choice load (Hick-Hyman)
axes.definition: log2(rows + 1): choice time grows with the options shown.

measurement.inputs: count of rows shown in a list/menu
measurement.formula: hick = log2(n + 1)

axes.scifin_reason: Category picker and account picker length.
axes.port_inputs: row count from probe

axes.name: Weekly navigation cost
axes.definition: Sum over every sought screen of its weekly weight x steps, with half a step added when the route works only from one place; screens have a home area and a depth, candidates state area costs and hubs (drawer, ⊞ sheet, top row, pin).

measurement.inputs: Static model: screens (weight, area, depth), candidate area costs and hub listings
measurement.formula: steps = min(area_cost + depth, hub_cost + 1); exp = steps + (0 if anywhere else 0.5); cost = sum w*exp; search-only areas cost search+1

axes.aggregation: Pareto with tail, max_depth, visible, hub, start_load, switch (low) and register, reach2, named1 (high); A++ pins chosen by enumerating all 3-pin combinations by cost.
axes.validation: nav_home.py reports how results move with NOT_ANYWHERE; reference apps measured by taps-per-job protocol (reference-protocol.md) for comparison.
axes.scifin_reason: Tab bar slots vs Add, budgets, goals, accounts, reports weighted by how often each is used.
axes.port_inputs: static screen list with weekly weights, area/depth, and each nav candidate's routes

axes.name: Long-tail navigation cost
axes.definition: The weekly cost restricted to screens weighing <= 1 a week, so rare screens are not sacrificed invisibly.

measurement.inputs: Same static model
measurement.formula: tail = sum w*exp over screens with w <= 1

axes.scifin_reason: Settings, export, recurring rules, categories management.
axes.port_inputs: as nav_weighted_cost

axes.name: Reach in 2 from anywhere
axes.definition: Screens reachable in two steps or fewer by a route that works from anywhere, without search; kept apart so a cheap one-place route does not hide a 2-step route from anywhere.

measurement.inputs: Static model
measurement.formula: count(reach_anywhere(screen) <= 2)

axes.scifin_reason: Same tab-bar design question.
axes.port_inputs: as nav_weighted_cost

axes.name: Named in 1 (screens named on persistent nav)
axes.definition: Screens whose own name is always on screen; a module label like 'Routines' names no single screen. Owner: 'pick a feature by its name'.

measurement.inputs: Static candidate definition
measurement.formula: len(named1)

axes.scifin_reason: Tab labels 'Budgets', 'Goals' vs a vague 'Plan'.
axes.port_inputs: static nav definition

axes.name: Module switch cost
axes.definition: Mean steps from inside one module to the start of another (a step back first when not reachable from anywhere); sibling: mean taps between screens of one module.

measurement.inputs: Static model
measurement.formula: switch = mean over main areas of (search+1 if none else max(cost,1) + (0 if anywhere else 1)); sibling: full 1.0, hide 1.5, top3 (3/n)*1+((n-3)/n)*2, none 2.0

axes.scifin_reason: Moving between Ledger, Budgets, Goals.
axes.port_inputs: static nav model

axes.name: Max depth, search-only, visible nav, largest list, start load
axes.definition: Deepest screen; screens with no browsable path; nav entries always on screen; the largest single list (bar, drawer, ⊞ sheet, menu); independent zones on the start screen.

measurement.inputs: Static candidate definition
measurement.formula: counts as stated per candidate

axes.aggregation: Pareto LOW set (search_only compared by count).
axes.scifin_reason: Overview home load (balance + budgets + goals + recent) and drawer size.
axes.port_inputs: static nav model

axes.name: Register (tone mixing on default surfaces)
axes.definition: 1 = no default surface mixes modules of different motivational tone (app-register-layout Step 1d); lower = mixed (allowed as zones, at a cost).

measurement.inputs: Hand-set per candidate
measurement.formula: assigned value 0.7-1.0

axes.validation: Not measured; hand-assigned.
axes.scifin_reason: Overview mixing urgent (overspend) and calm (goals) content; would need a rule for computing it.
axes.port_inputs: per-zone tone labels for each screen

axes.name: Find (items inspected in a launcher)
axes.definition: Expected items inspected to find a uniformly chosen feature in the ⊞ sheet: groups read one by one unless each is a filled hue region and G <= 6 (pop-out), then items one by one.

measurement.inputs: Static group sizes + coding
measurement.formula: pick = 1 if pop-out else (G+1)/2; within = (n+1)/2 (flat/cards) or folder/row variants; find = mean(pick + within)

axes.validation: Assumption stated (Treisman & Gelade 1980; Healey 1996); hue on text headings alone not counted.
axes.scifin_reason: Category grid in Add; Sci-Fin may not have a launcher.
axes.port_inputs: static group structure

axes.name: Judgment / guilt marks in view
axes.definition: Count of marks in view that judge the person: streaks, percentages, 'n/m done', empty past cells, missed cells, amounts shown as a fraction under target. A calm, non-judgmental register was the owner's aim.

measurement.inputs: DOM: elements tagged data-judge or data-cell=miss above the bar; empty past dots; fractions below target
measurement.formula: guilt = empty_past_dots + miss_cells + fractions_under_target (+ every row for the control's streaks); judgment_marks = count([data-judge] visible above bar)

axes.aggregation: Own 'Judgment' axis or in 'Calm' in every T3 part.
axes.validation: Control (streak + percentage + seven days per row) loses.
axes.scifin_reason: Highly relevant to budgets/goals (over-budget red, '% spent', missed savings); Sci-Fin must tag which elements judge.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with a 'judges' flag on elements (e.g. overspend badges, percent-of-goal, streaks)

axes.name: Presence stated / says share
axes.definition: Share of rows that state their state (today's value, last time) without opening them; presence_marks counts how many marks it takes (none 0, count 1, last 1, dots 13).

measurement.inputs: DOM probe of rows
measurement.formula: says_share = rows_with_statement / rows; presence_marks per presence style

axes.scifin_reason: Budget rows stating 'left this month' in one figure vs bars + percent + dots.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON rows with a 'states value' flag and mark count

axes.name: Words per row (low capacity)
axes.definition: Mean words per visible row; for low-capacity days less to read is better.

measurement.inputs: DOM text of rows above the bar
measurement.formula: words / rows

axes.scifin_reason: Transaction rows (payee, category, account, note).
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON text per row

axes.name: Titles cut / legible share / title room
axes.definition: Titles clipped (scrollWidth > clientWidth), the readable share of each title (whole, unbroken, unclipped words over all its words), and the mean width a title has left after labels/actions.

measurement.inputs: DOM text boxes vs their overflow
measurement.formula: cut = count(scrollWidth > clientWidth + 1); legible = mean(chars_readable/total); title_room = mean title width px

axes.aggregation: Density / Legibility / Calm axes; 'no title cut' as a gate in T3 measure2.
axes.validation: legible_share replaced raw characters, which favoured views with longer visible titles.
axes.scifin_reason: Payee names and amounts truncating on 360 dp; probe must expose text overflow (Compose TextLayoutResult.hasVisualOverflow).
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON: per text node full text, visible text or overflow flag, width

axes.name: Label/chip cost on rows
axes.definition: What tags/labels cost a row: extra height, wrapped lines, labels hidden behind +n, rows pushed below the bar, plus 'apart' cues that tell a label from the title without colour.

measurement.inputs: DOM probe of rows with labels
measurement.formula: extra_h = mean added height; lines = label lines beyond first; hidden = labels behind +n; rows_lost = rows pushed below bar vs no-label baseline; apart = count of cues (smaller text, dim ink, boundary, leading mark)

axes.aggregation: Pareto/rank sums in label_opt part A.
axes.scifin_reason: Category and tag chips on transaction rows.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON rows with chip bounds; baseline render without chips

axes.name: Kind separation (preattentive channels)
axes.definition: For each pair of item kinds shown, the share of three preattentive channels that differ: region (zone/lane/section), shape (height, width, radius, dash bucketed) and leading glyph. 1: every pair differs on all three.

measurement.inputs: DOM probe of items tagged with kind
measurement.formula: per kind modal (region, (h//12, round(w/360*4), radius, dash), glyph); kind_sep = mean over pairs of (#differing channels / 3); 0 if one kind

axes.scifin_reason: Income vs expense vs transfer vs scheduled rows told apart without relying on colour.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON rows with kind tag, bounds, corner radius, leading glyph id, container id

axes.name: Lookup cost in reading order
axes.definition: Readables (items, hour labels, section headers) the eye passes to answer 'what is at 09:00'; if the reading order is not in time order, every readable counts.

measurement.inputs: DOM readables with y, x, time
measurement.formula: order by (y//8, x); if times monotone cost = index+1 else len(order); mean over targets

axes.scifin_reason: Finding a transaction by date in the ledger, or a bill in an upcoming list.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON readables with key (date/amount) and bounds

axes.name: Disorder against time / soonest position
axes.definition: Share of item pairs out of time order in a list, and where the soonest item sits.

measurement.inputs: DOM order of items with due time
measurement.formula: disorder = count(pairs with a.time > b.time)/pairs; soonest_at = position of soonest

axes.scifin_reason: Upcoming bills / scheduled transactions list.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON list order + item dates

axes.name: Conflict visibility cost
axes.definition: For known overlapping event pairs: 0 if drawn side by side, 1 if both show times, 2 if a clash is unseen.

measurement.inputs: DOM boxes of event pairs
measurement.formula: mean over pairs of {0 if yoverlap > 2 and xoverlap <= 1; 1 if both timed; else 2}

axes.scifin_reason: Calendar-specific; no overlapping-time concept in Sci-Fin screens.

axes.name: Horizon (days on screen)
axes.definition: Span of days whose events are visible on screen, phone and desktop.

measurement.inputs: DOM event boxes with day
measurement.formula: max(day) - min(day) + 1

axes.scifin_reason: Days of spending (or months of a trend) visible at once.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON rows with date

axes.name: Mis-tap risk under scatter
axes.definition: A tap aimed at the safe target's centre lands with a round Gaussian scatter; aim_risk = probability it lands on a destructive target, snooze_miss = probability it misses the intended one, slap_risk = share of screen that acts on a blind tap. Added because without it a control reached the front.

measurement.inputs: DOM boxes of intended and dangerous targets
measurement.formula: P_in(box) = Phi_x * Phi_y with sigma; aim = sum over bad boxes P_in; miss = 1 - P_in(intended); slap = sum(bad area)/(360*740)

axes.validation: Introduced after the control (small Snooze word) reached the front without it.
axes.scifin_reason: Use alert sigma for Delete next to Save, or confirm-transfer buttons; groggy scenario does not apply.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON bounds of intended and destructive targets; chosen sigma in dp

axes.name: Safety counts (lost on back, accident, silent subset, gesture clash, distance to destructive)
axes.source: tools/screens/toast_opt.py:796-806 (AXES Safety), actions_opt.py:389-396, t2_opt.py AXES (lost_on_back, skip_accident)
axes.definition: Counted risks: edits lost on back without asking, an accidental destructive action reachable by a common gesture, a multi-selection silently applying to a subset, gesture clashes with scroll, the distance between the 'go' and 'keep' buttons, an extra confirming step.

measurement.inputs: Static walk per variant plus DOM distances
measurement.formula: binary/count per scenario; go_distance and back_px in px between buttons

axes.validation: Control dialogs ('Are you sure?' Yes filled under the thumb) lose.
axes.scifin_reason: Deleting a transaction, discarding an unsaved entry, bulk recategorise.
axes.port_inputs: declared scenarios + probe bounds of paired buttons

axes.name: Toast notice: look distance, undo seen, read margin
axes.definition: How far a toast sits from where the person acted (px), whether Undo is seen, and the safety margin: toast duration minus time to read its longest text at 238 wpm.

measurement.inputs: DOM: toast and acting element positions; toast text
measurement.formula: look = mean |undo.y - act.y| (desktop: hypot); read_s = words / (238/60); margin_s = timing - read_s(longest)

axes.scifin_reason: 'Transaction added / deleted, Undo' snackbar placement relative to Add and tab bar.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON of snackbar and acted-on element; snackbar text and duration

axes.name: Copy tone: words, reading grade, cheer, blame
axes.definition: For every sentence a state shows: word count, Flesch-Kincaid grade, cheer (congratulating words, '!', emoji) and blame (words putting fault on the user). Rule: 'one plain sentence and one action, no illustration, no cheer, no guilt'.

measurement.inputs: Static strings drawn on the screen
measurement.formula: grade = 0.39*words/sentences + 11.8*syllables/words - 15.59 (syllables = vowel groups, minus silent final e); cheer = count(CHEER words) + '!' + pictographic emoji; blame = count(BLAME phrases)

axes.validation: Word lists are a stated assumption from the 2026-10-07 rule, not a study. Compared with 16 phone apps (empty-references.json).
axes.scifin_reason: Empty ledger, over-budget and error copy in a money app is exactly where blame/cheer creep in.
axes.port_inputs: string resources per screen state

axes.name: State clarity (names it, says fix, says safe, persists)
axes.definition: Binary checks on error/empty states: says what happened, says data is safe, offers a fix, the error stays until fixed, names which item/filter.

measurement.inputs: Static per variant
measurement.formula: sum of booleans

axes.scifin_reason: Sync/import failure banners, invalid amount field.
axes.port_inputs: declared per state

axes.name: Loading stability (layout shift, blocks)
axes.definition: Whether content moves when loading finishes and whether loading blocks the screen; something to read while loading.

measurement.inputs: DOM boxes before/after load
measurement.formula: layout_shift = displacement of rows between loading and loaded states; blocks = boolean

axes.scifin_reason: Ledger loading from DB; needs two probes per state.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON for loading and loaded states

axes.name: Predictable (items move on their own)
axes.definition: 1 when the order changes on its own as use changes (most-recent-first, hybrid fits), 0 when it is manual; plus log_varies/unconfirmed (what Log does varies per row).

measurement.inputs: Static variant property
measurement.formula: moves = 1 if order in (recent, hybrid) else 0

axes.scifin_reason: Category picker sorted by recent use vs fixed order.
axes.port_inputs: declared

axes.name: Recovery: one-tap writes
axes.definition: Share of logs (frequency-weighted) written by a single tap with no confirming step: the cost of an accidental write.

measurement.inputs: Static walk + frequency profile
measurement.formula: oneshot_freq / logged_freq

axes.scifin_reason: Quick-add of recurring expenses; in money, one-tap writes are riskier, so weigh against taps.
axes.port_inputs: declared entry paths + frequencies

axes.name: Consistency with an approved pattern
axes.source: tools/screens/t3_opt.py:2244-2268 (like_today, like_when, like_item_page); toast_opt AXES g (spread_px, ways_in); actions_opt (sort_stray, duplicate_paths, one_model)
axes.definition: Whether a variant works like an already-approved screen (Today rows, When sheet, item page), how far the same action sits across screens (spread_px), and how many ways in there are.

measurement.inputs: Static comparison with approved variant; DOM positions across screens
measurement.formula: like_x = 0/1 differences; spread_px = spread of the same action's position over screens; ways_in = count

axes.scifin_reason: Add placement identical across Ledger/Budgets/Goals; edit sheets that work alike.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON across screens; list of approved patterns

axes.name: Distance from reference apps
axes.definition: Mean over variant dimensions of the share of reference apps whose choice differs from the variant's: how unfamiliar the design is to people coming from those apps.

measurement.inputs: Reference apps' normalised choices (t2-refs.json etc.)
measurement.formula: per key: sum(ref != v)/n_refs; ref_distance = mean over keys

axes.scifin_reason: Needs a table of reference finance apps' choices (tab layout, Add placement).
axes.port_inputs: reference apps' design choices as a JSON table

axes.name: Palette contrast bands per role
axes.definition: Every role solved to a contrast target on fixed neutral grounds: ink on ground 7-15.8:1 (comfort ceiling), primary per module 6.5/5.0/4.5, secondary 4.5, tertiary 3.2 (WCAG 1.4.11), ink on container >= 7, accent on tint >= 3, on-accent >= 4.5, in gamut.

measurement.inputs: Palette hex values (designkit WCAG ratio)
measurement.formula: pass/fail per check per theme (light, dark, OLED); lightness solved to hit target

axes.scifin_reason: Sci-Fin theme tokens (light/dark) can be checked directly.
axes.port_inputs: theme token hex values per role and theme

axes.name: Accent separation and colour-vision separation
axes.definition: Module primaries pairwise CIEDE2000 >= 20 and >= 10 under protanopia and deuteranopia in light and dark; roles >= 12 apart; every accent >= 15 from reserved state colours. Colour is never the only channel.

measurement.inputs: Palette hex values; designkit CVD simulation
measurement.formula: min pairwise dE2000 (normal, protan, deutan); tritan reported not gated

axes.aggregation: Gate plus objective in non-dominated sorting (harmony fit, min separation, min CVD separation, chroma balance).
axes.scifin_reason: Income/expense/transfer and chart category colours must stay apart for CVD users.
axes.port_inputs: palette hex values

axes.name: Palette score: harmony, fidelity, separation
axes.definition: Weighted score per palette choice: harmony template fit 0.45, source fidelity 0.35, role separation 0.20 (capped at dE 25); personality levers (hue band, chroma, contrast spread, container lightness, gaps, scale) are design assumptions for the owner's three words.

measurement.inputs: Palette hues/LCh; lexicon source colours
measurement.formula: score = 0.45*harmony + 0.35*fidelity + 0.20*min(sep/25, 1)

axes.aggregation: Weighted (the only hand-weighted composite in the group).
axes.validation: Page reports what each lever produced so a word that did not show in the colours is visible.
axes.scifin_reason: Only if Sci-Fin picks palettes from a lexicon; needs designkit harmony templates.
axes.port_inputs: candidate palettes + source swatches

axes.name: Reserved state colour cost
axes.definition: Reserving a hue for a state (done, due soon, attention) costs every lexicon colour within dE 15 of it; states themselves must be dE >= 20 apart (>= 10 under protan/deutan) and attention must have the set's highest chroma. Red forbidden.

measurement.inputs: Candidate state colours, lexicon colours
measurement.formula: lost = count(lexicon colours within dE 15 of any reserved state); constraints as stated; ties to fewer reserved hues

axes.scifin_reason: Over-budget / overdue-bill colours vs category colours; red-free rule is Factotum-specific.
axes.port_inputs: state colour candidates + category palette

axes.name: Series colour quality (unique, CVD-readable charts, readable, clash, taps)
axes.definition: For N user items given colours by a scheme (fixed k list, free picker, guided picker): share of items >= dE 10 from every other (the 'Notion problem'), share of random 2/3/4/6-series charts readable by protan and deutan viewers (or directly labelled), share >= 3:1 on both light and dark cards, share within dE 15 of reserved/forbidden hues, extra taps to set a colour.

measurement.inputs: Simulated colour assignments, user models (defaults / free)
measurement.formula: Monte Carlo averages over trials per N

axes.scifin_reason: Spending category colours on charts with many categories.
axes.port_inputs: category colour scheme; simulation of N categories

axes.name: Behaviour-case coverage per owner vs schema growth
axes.definition: Model contests: share of each owner's behaviour cases an option expresses (0/0.5/1, simulated results override hand marks) against schema growth (tables + columns + enum cases); options with violations rejected; a control must fail its expected cases or the run exits 2.

measurement.inputs: cases.jsonl, options.json, optional sim.json
measurement.formula: cov[owner] = mean(expresses); growth = tables+columns+enum_cases; Pareto (cov high, growth low)

axes.validation: Control gate: exit 2 if the control passes a case it must fail.
axes.scifin_reason: Schema/data-model contest, not a screen axis; the control-gate idea transfers (see notes).

axes.name: Placeholder copy (kinds named, verb-first, context, length; fits one line)
axes.definition: Placeholder text scored on how many common kinds it names, whether it starts with a verb, whether it names what the current screen will make, and characters/words; must fit one line (constraint measured from the render).

measurement.inputs: Strings + rendered line height
measurement.formula: counts/booleans; constraint: line height with placeholder == one-line height

axes.scifin_reason: Amount/payee field hints on the Add sheet.
axes.port_inputs: string resources + probe line height

axes.name: Primary-action spacing
axes.definition: Smallest gap between the submit target and any other target, keyboard top included (more is safer).

measurement.inputs: Model/probe bounds
measurement.formula: min distance between submit box and other boxes

axes.validation: Model layouts re-rendered and re-measured (tier_t1).
axes.scifin_reason: Save button next to the numeric keypad on the Add sheet.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON bounds incl. keyboard/keypad

notes: Scope: tools/screens/*.py (55 files, ~17.5k lines; the inventory lists none of them as duplicated), tools/score_contest.py, docs/screens/t0/nav-glance.md, docs/screens/t1/scores.md and docs/screens/t0/reference-protocol.md. Nothing was run. Method shared across the group: every screen part is an enumerated design space, rendered in headless Edge at 360x740 (phone) and 1100x660 (Windows), in light and dark. Each variant is measured with the same JS probe (screen_score.MEASURE_JS) and the same pixel metrics, then ranked by Pareto front or by rank sums per axis (Borda: capture_v2.ranks averages ties inside per-measure tolerances, and an axis sums its measures' ranks, or takes the worse rank with 'max:' keys). The front is taken over the axes. There are no hand weights, except palette_personality_score at 0.45/0.35/0.20. Constraints act as gates: 48 dp targets, no title cut, 0 hidden, over_box 0, owner rules. In T3 one measure can lead (T.LEAD): fewest taps, with a 0.17-0.25 tolerance. VALIDATION PATTERN worth porting: every part has a deliberately bad control, and the run fails (exit 2, or 'The control is on the front: the measures are not discriminating') if the control is not beaten. Clutter is also calibrated against real apps' screenshots (0.011 to 0.079 at 360 px wide) and checked for threshold robustness. Measurement bugs found and fixed: (1) headless --dump-dom laid out at 492x648 whatever --window-size said, which falsely hid targets, so pages are now measured in a larger window; (2) position-only visibility counted cut-off cards as seen, so it is now hit-tested; (3) cold browser launches held the CPU at 100% on a 10k-option run, so cdp.py now keeps one browser per worker and a partial jsonl resumes stopped runs. Superseded or merged: nav_score.py (job costs, 2026-10-05) into nav_score2; nav_glance 'primary' into strong_targets; title_edges and capture 'edges' into alignment_edges; sheet_weight mass, capture_v2 emphasis, picker 'heavy', hub header share and alarm dismiss_pull into visual_mass_emphasis; the various cover_px, banner_px, block_px and sheet_h into covered_share. Not catalogued as screen axes (too domain-specific): shorthand token clash (shorthands.py), legend readable-count (legend_opt), repeat-rule coverage (repeat_opt), cron and picker-specific task sets, and the purpose_map checks (structural lints). For Sci-Fin, most DOM-based axes need a Compose probe that provides bounds in dp, a clickable/role flag, text colour and resolved background, font size, a text-overflow flag and z-order/overlay membership. Pixel axes (clutter, mass, empty_share, focal) need only the PNG at known density, scaled to 360 dp wide.
